Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Rajesh Iyengar. I am a 33-year-old college lecturer living in Bengaluru. Ravi Bhosale gave me a cheque for Rs 1,50,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque came back with the remark account closed. My case number is CC/150/2019 in the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Bengaluru. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 82009 09019 or email rajesh.iyengar7@example.com.
